name: huddle-duel
description: Huddle Duel: a football play-calling dice game for iPhone and Android.

scripts.setup:ios: npm run fonts && node scripts/add-platform.mjs ios && node scripts/patch-native.mjs ios && npx cap sync ios
scripts.setup:android: npm run fonts && node scripts/add-platform.mjs android && node scripts/patch-native.mjs android && npx cap sync android
